text:
kevin: deploy-bot just paused the promotion. Staging canaries are failing on artifact uploads — multipart uploads timing out and the shared cache is spiking MRU evictions.

deploy-bot: Promotion paused (reason: artifact_upload_backpressure).

kevin: Quick logs: 
```
uploader: multipart upload chunk write timeout after 25s
registry: 503 slow_down x 37
cache-shard-12: eviction spike, write queue backlog
```

tara: Saw this yesterday in a different pipeline. Workarounds: 1) reduce multipart concurrency, 2) switch to fallback registry endpoint in eu-west, or 3) pin to last-good image and rerun CI.

kevin: Change window starts in ~55 minutes. My inclination is to pin to last-good sha and avoid risking a rollback mid-window. Thoughts?

tara: +1 for pin. Less blast radius. If infra can warm another shard we can unpin later.

ci-runner-bot: Scheduled rerun on pinned image: pipeline #4902 (queued).

kevin: Filed promo-pin: https://deploybot/internal/pins/2801234567  pinned to sha256:8c9a2d7e. Note: "manual pin due to artifact upload backpressure / MRU eviction spike". Also lowered multipart concurrency to 3 for the rerun.

infra-oncall: Investigating cache-shard-12. Seeing long tail write latencies and many small concurrent writes caused by multipart chunk sizes. Temporarily scaling the shard group and increasing the write buffer to reduce backpressure.

kevin: Good. I'll update the release notes: "Promo held - pinned to last-good image due to artifact upload backpressure; infra investigating cache shard drain." Marking the cut as "held - pinned" in the release tracker.

tara: Add a short follow-up checklist: collect uploader logs, shard write latency (P50/P95/P99), registry 503 counts, and deploy-bot backpressure counters. We'll need that for the postmortem.

infra-oncall: Quick update: scaled shard group and bumped buffer. Observing reduced queue length and fewer 503s. If stabilization continues for 10m, recommend unpin and proceed.

kevin: Hold for 10m then decide. If infra can't stabilize we keep the pin and move promo to next window. Posting status updates to #release-updates.
